title: Internal-State Hallucination Detection: Code and Data (LLM Lens)
description:
Code, configurations and released data for studies of hallucination probes that read the hidden states of large language models (Qwen3-8B and Ministral-3-8B): weakly supervised training with a three-judge LLM panel, probe architectures M0–M4 and simple controls, transfer to four further QA datasets, a 480-response blinded human reference study, durability under same-family model replacement and LoRA updates, and recovery by recalibration, source-initialized refitting and unlabeled alignment.

Contents: source code and experiment configurations; generated responses with questions and gold answers (source passages not redistributed); judge verdicts and consensus labels; de-identified human references; output probabilities of every reported probe fit; derived result tables; analysis and figure scripts.
